subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Dynamic Content and Live Regions
description: A 60-second lesson on Dynamic Content and Live Regions.

hook.text: A chat app receives a new message. Sighted users see it instantly. Screen reader users don't know it arrived.

buildup.text: Dynamic content changes that appear without a page reload are invisible to screen readers by default.

discovery.text: ARIA live regions announce dynamic changes to screen readers: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

twist.text: Overusing assertive live regions creates noise. Every small update interrupts the user's current task.

climax.text: Using polite for chat messages and assertive only for critical alerts balances awareness with usability.

punchline.text: Dynamic content needs live regions. Choose the right urgency level.

quiz.question: When should 'assertive' live regions be used?
options: Only for critical alerts that need immediate attention
